title: Sultan: The Saviour
desc: Raja Dutta and his sister Disha move to Kolkata to start afresh. But Disha is oblivious to Raja's past and his intention behind shifting to Kolkata.

title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Tor Naam
desc: Tor Naam is a sweet teenage love story which begins in a boarding school in Sikkim and ends with an interesting twist.

title: Sindoor Niye Khela
desc: Varsha is a powerful businesswoman, but faces opposition from her workers. In order to solve the problem, she marries the leader of the workers' union.

title: Satyam Shivam Sundaram
desc: Laxmi, a milkmaid, falls in love with Kanchan, an influential zamindar's son. Things take a tragic turn when his family disapproves of their alliance.

title: Ekai Eksho
desc: Ratan, an honest autorickshaw driver, refuses to help a corrupt politician, Pradip Roy, which then leads to a local war. He also ends up falling in love with Jhilik, his daughter.

title: Sathihara
desc: Musicians Anuradha and Jeet fall in love and marry, but their relationship is tested when Anuradha's thriving career begins to overshadow Jeet's ambitions.
